name: RPG Demo
author: ct
description: Content of the RPG demo (collection rpg_demo): a village, the elder's house and a forest with a wolf at the cave, made of rpg_map files over the village_pack tileset. Shows teleports, talking NPCs, events that change with story flags, chests, a map monster with a win flag and random encounters in the forest. Only data and scenarios, no C#.
